property_summary: For any caller and any nonzero sent value, after calling addToBalance with that value the contract's recorded userBalance for that caller increases by at least the sent value (i.e., new balance >= previous balance + sent value); the mutant that ignores msg.value breaks this because balances do not increase when msg.value>0.
change_summary: Replace the balance-increment expression with an addition that ignores msg.value (adds zero), so userBalance is unchanged after addToBalance calls.
